race.comment: COSMIC GRACE (6) has been in the market at her last couple of runs but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest eighth at Albury over 1400m. Rates highly in this line up and can improve. TA LA MASCA (8) was in the money two starts back at Tumut but was unable to repeat the effort last time when sixth, beaten 8 lengths, at Gundagai over 1000m. Has the class to put the recent run behind him. DENSETSU (2) finished ninth two runs back at Wangaratta then improved last time out to score by half a length as favourite over 1170m at Wangaratta. Looks well placed so expect another big run. THE FAVORITE SON (12) hit the frame when resuming two runs back at Tumut but couldn't back it up last start when sixth, beaten 3 lengths, over 1180m at Gundagai. Expect a better run this time.
